transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I guess... I'm just here because it's wearing me down. For the past year, I've been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is changing or holding back parts of my dad's lab results. No matter how many doctors or family members tell me the numbers are fine... I know the chart doesn't match what I saw. I'm just tired of it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No. ...I don't hear anything like that.
Over the past several months, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
No. ...I'm not depressed. Just tired of dealing with all of this. That's all.
Have you been diagnosed with any physical medical conditions or experienced any head injuries?
No. ...I haven't had any head injuries or anything like that. I'm physically fine.
Have you ever felt that an outside force was putting thoughts into your head or controlling you?
No. ...Nobody's putting thoughts in my head. I don't know what you mean by that.
Outside of this situation with your dad's lab results, do you generally suspect that people in other areas of your life, like friends or coworkers, are untrustworthy or trying to deceive you?
No. Just... no. My friends and coworkers are fine. It's just... the lab results. That's it.
